programmes.evidence: Official school PhD inventory lists Management Science among nine doctoral majors; its individual entry says the major has granted PhD degrees since 1996. The formal major title qualifies independently of a named department.
limitations: The site does not associate this major with an exact administrative department; no unit ID is inferred.

branches.conclusion: Opened official nine-major PhD inventory; Management Science (1201Z1) is qualifying. Logistics Management and Engineering, and Industrial Engineering professional-degree navigation are not counted as doctoral routes.
Other university engineering PhD specifications and units have not been inventoried.
